title: Brand
description: A single advertiser brand entry in the catalogue. ALL fields are required — a brand without negative_contexts would silently defeat the hard-block safety requirement.

brand_id.description: Stable unique identifier, snake_case, prefixed with 'brand_', e.g. 'brand_zestcola'

display_name.description: Human-readable brand name shown in UI and debug output

target_contexts.description: Scene activity/mood contexts in which this brand is a GOOD match (used for embedding cosine similarity ranking)

negative_contexts.description: Scene activity/mood contexts that HARD-BLOCK this brand from appearing. Must never be empty — every brand in every category has contexts where it would be inappropriate. An empty array would silently disable the safety filter for that brand.

creative_asset.description: Relative path to the brand's video creative file, e.g. 'assets/ads/zestcola_15s.mp4'

duration_sec.description: Duration of the creative asset in seconds (used for ad-load budget accounting)
